palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome with more than 255 characters:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
```

This example is 320 characters long and contains the common palindrome "Able was I ere I saw Elba."
